translationRepairs: In the eighth year of Wuding, Hou Jing rebelled. Shu was made masters of writing on the southeastern mobile grand secretariat and enfeoffed as marquis of Jiangxia. With Gao Yue and others he broke Hou Jing and took Xiao Ming prisoner.

In the eighth year of Wuding, Hou Jing rebelled. Shu was made masters of writing on the southeastern mobile grand secretariat and enfeoffed as nan (baron) of Jiangxia county. With Gao Yue and others he broke Hou Jing and took Xiao Ming prisoner.
封江夏縣男 enfeoffs Shu as nan of Jiangxia county; marquis would be 侯, so the original rank is wrong and the proposed nan (baron) of Jiangxia county matches the Chinese.
When the emperor was near death, he and Prince of Pingyuan Guiyan, Prince of Zhao Jun Rui, and others received the final charge and installed Gao Zhan.
When the emperor was near death, he and Prince of Pingqin Guiyan, Prince of Zhao Jun Rui, and others received the final charge and installed Gao Zhan.
平秦王歸彥 is Prince of Pingqin Guiyan; Pingyuan would be 平原 and is unsupported by this unit.
When he returned to announce the mourning he praised Yanshen at length, opened the commandery-and-county register for selection, and enfeoffed him as marquis of Anguo county.
When he returned to announce the mourning he praised Yanshen at length, opened the commandery-and-county register for selection, and enfeoffed him as baron of Anguo county.
封安國縣伯 is the rank bo (baron) of Anguo county; marquis would be 侯, so the original title is wrong and baron of Anguo county is correct.
